nodes.label: Reproducible Launcher-Independent Modpack
nodes.rationale: Every release must be reconstructible from manifests and reviewed overrides without coupling the modpack to one launcher.

nodes.label: Client-Server Scope Isolation
nodes.rationale: Client and server work must remain isolated, with the server frozen until the user starts that phase.

nodes.label: Canonical CurseForge Pack Source
nodes.rationale: The CurseForge package builder accepts this directory as its only input, excluding the raw profile.

nodes.label: Blocked Modrinth Export
nodes.rationale: CurseForge-centric metadata cannot safely be converted into a valid mrpack by guessing CDN URLs.

nodes.label: Reserved Server Scope
nodes.rationale: Agents must not add, migrate, or infer server configuration before the server phase is explicitly started.
